name: lhcb-b2pimumu-angular
description: Hand-checked facts from docs/references/papers/LHCb-PAPER-2026-015-1CWR.pdf (B+ -> pi+ mu+ mu- angular observables, first measurement). Tier 1 must always resolve; tier 2/3 may miss at most the configured fraction; one unresolved negative control guards against guessing.

questions.question: What integrated luminosity of proton-proton collisions was collected by the LHCb experiment for this measurement of the B+ to pi+ mu+ mu- angular distribution?
questions.notes: Abstract and introduction both state 9 fb-1 collected with LHCb.

questions.question: Which two angular observables parameterise the differential decay rate of the B+ to pi+ mu+ mu- decay in cos theta_l?
In which invariant-mass window are the B+ to pi+ mu+ mu- candidates selected for the cos theta_l distributions?
questions.notes: 5260 < m(pi+ mu+ mu-) < 5300 MeV/c^2, about twice the mass resolution.

questions.question: What are the observed signal yields in the low-q2 and high-q2 regions of the fit?
In which two q2 regions is the angular distribution analysed in this paper?
At what confidence levels are the measured observables found to be consistent with Standard Model predictions?
questions.notes: 99% CL in the low-q2 region, 68% CL in the high-q2 region.

questions.question: Which source of systematic uncertainty is the largest one on F_H?
questions.notes: Knowledge of the q2 spectrum of the signal (efficiency-model systematics).

questions.question: Which type of quark transition mediates the B+ to pi+ mu+ mu- decay at leading order in the Standard Model?
questions.notes: b- to d-quark flavour-changing neutral-current transition.

questions.question: What value of the CKM weak mixing angle gamma is measured in this paper?
questions.notes: Negative control: the paper measures A_FB and F_H, never the angle gamma; the harness must record this as unresolved instead of guessing.
